title: Testimonials
description: The rotating testimonial carousel. Each testimonial has a quote, author, and location. Add/remove as many as you like.

fields.label: Auto-rotate interval (ms)
fields.name: testimonials_interval_ms
fields.instructions: How long each testimonial stays on screen before rotating. 5500 = 5.5 seconds.

sub_fields.label: Quote
sub_fields.name: quote
sub_fields.instructions: Don't wrap in quotation marks; the theme adds them.

sub_fields.label: Author
sub_fields.name: author
sub_fields.instructions: Name or names of the person(s) being quoted.

sub_fields.label: Location / context
sub_fields.name: location
sub_fields.instructions: City + state, or project type. Shown in small text under the author.
